initiatives.name: Rockford Promise
initiatives.description: Nonprofit that funds college scholarships for Rockford Public Schools District 205 and partner private school graduates, with mentoring and academic advising.

initiatives.name: Bridges to Prosperity Northern IL
initiatives.description: Nonprofit in Rockford that runs 'Getting Ahead' programs and consults with communities and organizations on poverty reduction and economic mobility.

initiatives.name: 815 Mutual Aid
initiatives.description: Rockford, Illinois mutual aid collective that delivers food and supplies, runs jail support, and does political education. Describes itself as anti-capitalist and abolitionist.
